  (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal) (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
  (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n) (j : Fin n)
  (u : ℕ),
  0 < u →
    ∀ (a : ℕ) (ω : Ω),
      (fun a ω =>
              (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.uncovered labels
                  ((fun a ω =>
                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω)
                          (fun k r => answer k r ω) a)
                      a ω).1
                  ((fun a ω =>
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω)
                            (fun k r => answer k r ω) a)
                        a ω).2.1
                  j).length)
            a ω =
          u →
        ((fun a ω =>
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω) (fun k r => answer k r ω)
                      a)
                  a ω).1.length ≤
            (fun a ω =>
                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.uncovered labels
                      ((fun a ω =>
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω)
                              (fun k r => answer k r ω) a)
                          a ω).1
                      ((fun a ω =>
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω)
                                (fun k r => answer k r ω) a)
                            a ω).2.1
                      j).length)

              (↑j + 1) →
          ((fun a ω =>
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω) (fun k r => answer k r ω)
                        a)
                    a ω).1.length ≤

            ¬((fun a ω =>
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.dispatchContext n labels x start (rows ω)
                            (fun k r => answer k r ω) a)
                        a ω).1.length ≤
                  u + min (↑j + 1) labels.length →
